How can volunteers make food bank visitors feel welcome?

document_clean:
Food Bank Opening Information

The food bank is open on Tuesdays and Saturdays from 10am to 1pm, at St Mark's Hall on Bridge Street.

Visitors need a referral voucher from a doctor, school, or advice centre. Each voucher provides three days of food.

We can provide nappies and toiletries on request. Please tell us about any allergies when you arrive.

Volunteers are always welcome; contact the coordinator, Grace Mensah.
